Use this page as the curated reading list. Prefer a DOI or publisher link over uploading a copyrighted PDF. PDFs may be placed in `publications/files/` only when the team has permission to redistribute them.

## Reading list

No articles have been added yet.

For each article, add its citation to `references.bib`, then cite it in Quarto using `[@citation-key]`. A useful reading note includes:

- Full citation and DOI
- Why the paper matters to the project
- Population, samples, assay, and analysis method
- Main results and limitations
- Questions for the group

## Suggested organization

| Theme | Scope |
|---|---|
| Disease biology | Colitis phenotypes and inflammatory pathways |
| Epigenetics | DNA methylation mechanisms and interpretation |
| Assays | Arrays, sequencing, preprocessing, and quality control |
| Statistics | Differential methylation, cell composition, and confounding |
| Translation | Biomarkers, replication, and clinical relevance |
